races.name: KSR Lighting Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Despite failing to win a bumper between them, SMOKEHOUSE and The Mad Poet displayed plenty of ability and they could be the pair to focus on now hurdling. Marginal preference is for the Snowden inmate. Of the rest, point recruit Without Cause has to be of interest.

  1. SMOKEHOUSE (IRE)
  2. THE MAD POET (IRE)
  3. WITHOUT CAUSE (IRE)

races.name: OPC Home Guard Remembrance Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
SEA WARRIOR surpassed his hurdling form at first time of asking over fences when a ready winner here 2 weeks ago and his follow-up claims appear to be bright. Ahanaglogh was on the up from his low base when last seen and is a threat on reappearance, along with Koenigsstern.

  1. SEA WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. AHANAGLOGH (IRE)
  3. KOENIGSSTERN (IRE)

races.name: My Laces Cost More Than Your Shoes Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MILD MAGIC can win again for a yard that excels with her type. In-form I Love You Sivola is the most likely danger, with Docteur Romeo also worth a second look.

  1. MILD MAGIC (IRE)
  2. I LOVE YOU SIVOLA (FR)
  3. DOCTEUR ROMEO (FR)

races.name: Gary Wrights Big 40th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
It may pay to concentrate on SO YOU KNOW and Paso Doble, who both made winning reappearances last season. The former gets the nod on just his second start over a trip that really should suit. He's A Latchico could be a danger, if the market expects him to leave behind a lacklustre comeback run.

  1. SO YOU KNOW (IRE)
  2. PASO DOBLE (IRE)
  3. HE'S A LATCHICO (IRE)

races.name: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Assuming he copes with a 4-day turnaround, HARD STARE can put his fitness to good use and build on what was a promising chasing debut at Plumpton on Monday. Ted The Thief lacks an outing but is the obvious threat.

  1. HARD STARE
  2. TED THE THIEF (IRE)
  3. SWEET NIGHTINGALE

races.name: Weddings At Fontwell Park Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WINSTON'S OATH didn't look at home over the fixed-brush obstacles at Southwell 3 weeks ago but that was a pretty strong handicap for the grade and back at the scene of his breakthrough win, he can get back on track. Pippin's Legend and Eyeeye also contested that aforementioned race and showed enough to think they are the main threats.

  1. WINSTON'S OATH (IRE)
  2. PIPPIN'S LEGEND
  3. EYEEYE

races.name: Sidgwick Memorial Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DIAMOND MIX is building up a very good record round here and is weighted to repeat his win in this contest 12 months ago unless points runner-up Imperfectlyperfect proves well-above average on his first go over fences. Ghasham also has winning form over C&D and needs considering too.

  1. DIAMOND MIX (IRE)
  2. IMPERFECTLYPERFECT (IRE)
  3. GHASHAM (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LUNA MARQUESA was getting the hang of things late on when fifth on her recent hurdling debut at Worcester and with this stiffer track seeming sure to suit she is fancied to get off the mark and continue the fine run of Joe Tizzard. Kamille Au Kanada is feared most in her bid for a third hurdling success, although Just A Poet can't be ruled out after a break too.

  1. LUNA MARQUESA (FR)
  2. KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR)
  3. JUST A POET

races.name: carpetgallop.co.uk Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Joe Tizzard's WALK TALL impressed as a future chaser in the making in a relatively light campaign over hurdles last season and this winning pointer is taken to make a successful start in this sphere. Easy C&D scorer C'Mon So rates a big threat though, while Aill Dubh appeals as the pick of the remainder.

  1. WALK TALL (IRE)
  2. C'MON SO (IRE)
  3. AILL DUBH (IRE)

races.name: carpetgallop.co.uk Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SEAN OG is in good form and looks the most solid option here with race fitness on his side. The returning Ruby Island took well to chasing last year and is also considered, with Hombre de Guerra appealing as likely to come on from his yard debut.

  1. SEAN OG (IRE)
  2. RUBY ISLAND
  3. HOMBRE DE GUERRA (IRE)

races.name: carpetgallop.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TITANIUM RING ticks plenty of boxes and can make it a worthwhile journey for the Henry Daly team. Recent C&D winner Kool Raoul looks capable of another bold bid, while Bobby Socks makes each-way appeal at the forecast prices.

  1. TITANIUM RING (IRE)
  2. KOOL RAOUL (FR)
  3. BOBBY SOCKS

races.name: carpetgallop.co.uk Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BOY AARON showed plenty of ability on his sole bumper outing and can make a winning start over hurdles having joined the Adam Nicol yard. Point winner Elusive Dreams makes most appeal of the remainder.

  1. BOY AARON (IRE)
  2. ELUSIVE DREAMS (IRE)
  3. JEU DE MAINE (FR)

races.name: Debra Corner Happy Birthday Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Plenty of pace on paper. It could be worth taking a chance on JET NOIR, who's bred to stay well and begins life in handicaps on a lowly mark. Lady Phoebe and After Many Days also need considering in a wide-open race.

  1. JET NOIR (IRE)
  2. LADY PHOEBE (IRE)
  3. AFTER MANY DAYS

races.name: Bet 10 To Get 40 BetMGM Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RISKY OBSESSION's Aintree bumper form has been well advertised, and he's fancied to make a winning start over hurdles. Aqua Bleu showed plenty as a juvenile last season and is feared most at the weights.

  1. RISKY OBSESSION (IRE)
  2. AQUA BLEU (IRE)
  3. WATERY BORREN (IRE)

races.name: Download The BetMGM App Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for DIXIE MAFIA, who improved on his hurdles form straight away with an emphatic success on chasing debut at Perth in April. He seems sure to do better in this sphere and can see off the challenge of the hat-trick seeking Off The Jury, while it would be no surprise to see Barnpark leave his chasing/stable debut effort behind up in trip.

  1. DIXIE MAFIA (IRE)
  2. OFF THE JURY (IRE)
  3. BARNPARK

races.name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ALL IN YOU looks well treated on his win on softish ground at Sandown last winter and, fit from the Flat, can make a successful return to hurdling under Sean Bowen. Support for Dan Skelton French recruit Lyssenko would make him a potential big threat. Scottish Champion winner Dedicated Hero may prove best of the remainder.

  1. ALL IN YOU (FR)
  2. LYSSENKO (FR)
  3. DEDICATED HERO (IRE)

races.name: BetMGM 'Future Stars' Silver Bowl 'Chasing Excellence' Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Runner-up in a Grade 1 novice hurdle, KLIMT MADRIK has the physique to make at least as good a chaser and showed promise when runner-up at Worcester on his reappearance. He can build on that effort to go one better, though Royal Infantry made a winning chasing debut at Hexham and isn't taken lightly for the Skeltons.

  1. KLIMT MADRIK (FR)
  2. ROYAL INFANTRY (IRE)
  3. INTOSOMETHINGGOOD

races.name: BetMGM Haldon Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Grade 2) (Limited Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Successful in a Grade 1 novice here in April, MIRABAD made an encouraging return over hurdles when second in a listed race at Carlisle and he could still have more to offer as a chaser. He gets the vote ahead of JPR One, who showed that he retains all of his enthusiasm when defying top weight in a Cheltenham handicap on his reappearance, with Brookie also considered.

  1. MIRABAD (FR)
  2. JPR ONE (IRE)
  3. BROOKIE (IRE)

races.name: BetMGM Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
HERE COMES GEORGIE proved another fine advert for the sublime training skills of Dan Skelton at Cheltenham recently and can make light of a 7 lb rise for that strong-travelling success. Anthony Honeyball has an excellent recent record in this (when usually at Wincanton) and his Leave of Absence could prove the chief threat and the pick of his quartet. Montregard, Kap Vert and Konfusion all have plenty to recommend them too.

  1. HERE COMES GEORGIE
  2. LEAVE OF ABSENCE (FR)
  3. MONTREGARD (FR)

races.name: Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
QUAVISTE's promising run in the Morebattle at Kelso on his final outing of last season suggests it's surely only a matter of time before he's winning over hurdles. Limier d'Arthel shaped nicely on his handicap debut/reappearance at Worcester recently and is second choice ahead of ready Sedgefield maiden winner Mia Sunshine.

  1. QUAVISTE (FR)
  2. LIMIER D'ARTHEL (FR)
  3. MIA SUNSHINE (GER)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
There's a feeling the 3-y-os may come to the fore in this competitive opener. SOVEREIGN VIEW was tackling 1¼m for the first time when successful at Sandown in August and is narrowly preferred to Stoneacre Donny. Low-mileage pair Light of Paris and Black Chiffon are other 3-y-os with something to recommend them. Rajapour and Per Contra may prove best of the older brigade.

  1. SOVEREIGN VIEW
  2. STONEACRE DONNY
  3. LIGHT OF PARIS (GER)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A glorious opportunity for ENDLESS QUEST to make it 2-2. Maneater looks by far the best of the rest.

  1. ENDLESS QUEST (IRE)
  2. MANEATER
  3. MALIKA

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
Although ODEGAARD finished behind Miss You Nights at Wolverhampton, he caught the eye with the way he ran on and may be able to turn the tables on Jack Channon's charge on 4 lb better terms. Texting should benefit from the drop back to 7f and is next on the list ahead of Printing Money, another from the Miss You Nights Wolverhampton race.

  1. ODEGAARD
  2. MISS YOU NIGHTS
  3. TEXTING

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Nursery
races.verdict:
NORTHERN VIOLA is going the right way and is taken to back up her recent C&D success from 4 lb higher mark. Beauty For Love also improved last time and steps up further in trip so could have more to come, while March Lilly should be much more at home up to 1m.

  1. NORTHERN VIOLA
  2. BEAUTY FOR LOVE (IRE)
  3. MARCH LILLY

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MOBILIZING is a €450,000 purchase and half-sister to useful 2-y-o 5f/6f winners, so is fancied to make a winning debut if the market speaks in her favour. Stablemate Capricious Star showed promise when third at Redcar 21 days ago and is the type to improve so could be the selection's biggest danger, while Lizzie Bennet could do better if she learns to settle.

  1. MOBILIZING (IRE)
  2. CAPRICIOUS STAR (IRE)
  3. LIZZIE BENNET

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
In a wide-open sprint, it could be worth taking a chance on FRANTIC in first-time blinkers. Course winners Jenever and King's Crown are feared most, with Simba's Pride and Go Victor others to consider.

  1. FRANTIC
  2. JENEVER
  3. KING'S CROWN (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict:
BOOK OF LIFE and Kelpie Grey are both well treated if things fall right, the former narrowly shading the vote. Barleybrown, Archangel Josepi and Oxford Circus also need a close look in a competitive handicap.

  1. BOOK OF LIFE
  2. KELPIE GREY
  3. BARLEYBROWN

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BLAZING SON has 3 C&D wins to his name and still looks very well treated on old form after recent 3 lb rise so could well follow up at the expense of Showtime Mahomes, who can bounce back returned to all-weather, and the consistent Wise Crack.

  1. BLAZING SON
  2. SHOWTIME MAHOMES
  3. WISE CRACK (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MARIANNE MOZART is putting it all together now, having shown improved form in a first-time hood before building on that promise to get off the mark at Kempton 9 days ago. She runs off an unchanged mark and can follow up. Lord Abama is only 2 lb higher than for a recent course success and that leaves him still very well treated on old form so he's respected and Pit Boss is capable if getting some luck and the race is run to suit his hold-up style.

  1. MARIANNE MOZART (IRE)
  2. LORD ABAMA (IRE)
  3. PIT BOSS

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Your First For Football' Maiden
races.verdict:
GRANDE CUVEE looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to gain a first success on the back of a resurgent Navan second recently. Otsana appeals as the one to chase her home ahead of Emiza.

  1. GRANDE CUVEE (IRE)
  2. OTSANA (IRE)
  3. EMIZA (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SENSATIONAL FILLY holds the clear edge on form and is fancied to build on her recent Leopardstown second and get off the mark. C&D debut third Ladies Gossip also has better days ahead of her and can chase home Paddy Twomey's promising Mehmas filly ahead of stablemate Corsican Night, who warrants a market check on her debut.

  1. SENSATIONAL FILLY (FR)
  2. LADIES GOSSIP (IRE)
  3. CORSICAN NIGHT (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Acca Boost' Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SOARING SUN hasn't been at his best on turf since going in over C&D early in the year and is taken to bounce back in style now returned to his favoured polytrack. Baila Conmigo can also boast C&D-winning form and is next on the list ahead of Autocrat and Pralognan.

  1. SOARING SUN (IRE)
  2. BAILA CONMIGO (IRE)
  3. AUTOCRAT (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but AVIATRICE took this prize a year ago and is fancied to repeat the feat on the back of an excellent second here last time. Multiple course winner Carolina Jetstream heads the list of dangers, although a solid case can also be made for Suzie Songs, Leading Dancer and Prevalence.

  1. AVIATRICE (IRE)
  2. CAROLINA JETSTREAM
  3. SUZIE SONGS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
Chesham Stakes runner-up ON JUST TERMS sets a clear standard and can make a winning comeback after a 5-month break. Selosse remains with potential on the back of his Curragh debut, with Drive On There completing the shortlist.

  1. ON JUST TERMS (USA)
  2. SELOSSE (IRE)
  3. DRIVE ON THERE (USA)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting '2Up Early Payout' Handicap
races.verdict:
The consistent DALER looks a very solid proposition having been only narrowly denied over C&D last week and gets the verdict over Exquisite Acclaim, who has rather encouragingly been able to string a couple of positive efforts together. Stable-switcher Jolly Roger merits a second look in the betting.

  1. DALER (IRE)
  2. EXQUISITE ACCLAIM (IRE)
  3. JOLLY ROGER (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Bet Builder Boost Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
HOOVES YOUR DADDY ran up to her best when staying on for fourth here last time and looks worth a try at this longer trip. She could be ready to get off the mark, though Wegotogether arrives in good heart and isn't taken lightly back in headgear. Una Matata and Jazzy Dancer complete the shortlist.

  1. HOOVES YOUR DADDY (IRE)
  2. WEGOTOGETHER (IRE)
  3. UNA MATATA (IRE)

races.name: Race 1 - Emirates Airline Stakes
races.verdict:
MIDLAND MONEY's US form makes him the selection here. Colour Up should give his running and be thereabouts, with Echo Point the best of the rest.

  1. MIDLAND MONEY (USA)
  2. COLOUR UP (IRE)
  3. ECHO POINT (IRE)

races.name: Race 2 - Emirates Skywards Stakes
races.verdict:
TEN CARAT HARRY is well up to taking this provided he handles the surface. Union Security appeals as best of the rest.

  1. TEN CARAT HARRY
  2. UNION SECURITY (USA)
  3. ORDEP (USA)

races.name: Race 3 - Emirates Courier Express Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
JEYOUSH should appreciate the switch to dirt and makes most appeal under Oisin Murphy. Of the rest, the newcomers Blanc Canvas and Qasseer appeal most on paper.

  1. JEYOUSH (USA)
  2. BLANC CANVAS (USA)
  3. QASSEER (USA)

races.name: Race 4 - Emirates Holidays Handicap
races.verdict:
AL AMIR has joined a yard who have made a good start to the season and can gain a first win in the UAE. Laman Edelveys appeals as a big danger, while Norato should give a good account seeking a hat-trick on his belated return.

  1. AL AMIR (USA)
  2. LAMAN EDELVEYS (USA)
  3. NORATO (BRZ)

races.name: Race 5 - Sheikh Ahmed Bin Rashed Al Maktoum Cup Sponsored By Emirates Airline Handicap
races.verdict:
LAASUDOOD returns on a good mark and could be worth chancing. Gun Carriage is feared most, ahead of Royal Favour.

  1. LAASUDOOD (USA)
  2. GUN CARRIAGE (USA)
  3. ROYAL FAVOUR

races.name: Race 6 - Emirates Skycargo Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
MARSOOD just about sets the standard and can open his account. Jabal Jais took a step forward from debut and should be thereabouts, while Aztec Rose is taken to improve.

  1. MARSOOD (USA)
  2. JABAL JAIS (USA)
  3. AZTEC ROSE (USA)

races.name: Race 7 - Arabian Adventures (Benchmark 85 Handicap)
races.verdict:
The consistent NAM PHRIK gets the vote to make a winning return. Alsayel can be on the premises if ready to go on return from a lengthy absence, while Crown Estate may build on last week's effort.

  1. NAM PHRIK (BRZ)
  2. ALSAYEL (USA)
  3. CROWN ESTATE
